summary: Available August 2024 · Ideal Jesmond Location · Six Double Bedrooms · £125pppw
description:
My Property Box are pleased to offer a recently refurbished spacious six-bedroom maisonette on the ever-popular Shortridge Terrace in Jesmond. Available to a group of students, the property is set over two floors and includes six equally sized double bedrooms, three bathrooms, communal living room and large galley kitchen. Being only a short walk from Osborne Road, the spacious maisonette is perfectly situated to explore everything that Jesmond has to offer, and less than a 20min walk to both university campuses. Available from August 2024.

To arrange a viewing, contact MPB today.
